subject: PO field validation failure in Ariba / next steps for MSA + Order Form
messages:
From: James Smythe <j.smythe@horizonhealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@horizonhealth.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ariba PO import failing - Bill-To / PO number format

Hi Aditya,

We're seeing repeated failures when our Ariba instance tries to create POs for Redwood. Two things pop up in the validation logs:
- Several POs are being rejected because the Bill-To block is empty in the vendor record (Horizon requires Bill-To for routing).
- Ariba's PO number validator expects a numeric-only PO reference; Redwood's order form examples include the prefix "RDW-" which Ariba flags as non-compliant for our automated workflow.

Our procurement team is trying to automate three suppliers right now and Redwood is blocking the run. Can you confirm what fields Redwood requires on the order form and whether you can accept a numeric-only PO (we can also map a supplier-level field as a prefix if needed)?

We also need a copy of the countersigned Order Form/PO mapping so our onboarding automation can proceed. Attaching the Ariba error snapshot to the ticket: https://ariba-horizon.example.com/ticket/12847

Thanks,
James
Procurement Ops
Horizon Health

(Attachment: ariba_validation_log_12847.txt)

From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
To: James Smythe <j.smythe@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba PO import failing - Bill-To / PO number format

James — thanks for the quick heads up and the ticket link.

Short answers up front:
- Redwood's canonical Order Form accepts a PO identifier in a free-text field; we typically include an example with the RDW- prefix, but we can accept numeric-only PO numbers.
- The Bill-To block is required for invoicing; some Ariba vendor profiles strip that field during registration which causes the routing failure.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll attach a brief PO mapping CSV for your Ariba team that suggests a supplier-level mapping (we can either have Ariba inject the RDW- prefix at import or you can send numeric POs; both OK).
2) I'll escalate to legal for a narrow redline to the Order Form that clarifies the required invoicing fields and allows for numeric-only PO acceptance.
3) Grace (copied) — could you help loop in Marissa (legal) and route the redline?

I can block the automation run for one of your test suppliers this afternoon to replicate the failure and confirm mapping once legal signs off.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (555) 210-3344

(Attachments: none)

From: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Ariba PO import failing - Bill-To / PO number format

Marissa — looping you in. Customer is Horizon Health (DEAL-2027-HZN-0142). They have Ariba validation failures tied to Bill-To being empty and a PO-number regex mismatch (they prefer numeric-only). Aditya has offered a mapping CSV (see thread) and wants a narrowly scoped Order Form/M SA redline that:
- Specifies required invoicing fields (Bill-To, Ship-To, remit address, PO number) as mandatory for automated processing;
- Clarifies that Redwood can accept numeric-only POs and/or an agreed prefix mapping;
- Adds language on EDI/portal field mappings for procurement automation (minimal legal exposure).

Please advise whether we can: (A) issue a short Order Form addendum with explicit field mapping AND (B) provide an Order Form that omits the RDW- prefix example. If you want, I attached a proposed mapping file that Aditya will send to Horizon's Ariba team once approved.

Thanks — Grace
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

(Attachment forwarded: OrderForm_PO-mapping-proposal.csv)

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Ariba PO import failing - Bill-To / PO number format

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the Ariba error summary and the mapping proposal. High level: we can do a targeted redline to the Order Form (not the master MSA) that accomplishes the customer's automation needs without changing core commercial terms.

Proposed changes (short summary):
1) Add an Order Form Appendix A (PO Field Mapping) that lists required fields for automated invoicing: Bill-To, Ship-To, Remit Address, Invoice Contact, PO Number.
2) Add a sentence clarifying that Redwood will accept numeric-only PO identifiers and that either party may agree to a non-functional prefix mapping for display only (i.e., formatting only, not required for invoice processing).
3) Add an implementation note that for portal onboarding Redwood will provide a CSV mapping template; the customer (Horizon) must confirm field map prior to go-live.

I'll attach the redline PDF and the CSV template. If the customer agrees, sign the Order Form addendum (DocuSign link below) and then Aditya can confirm with the Ariba onboarding team.

Two legal caveats: we should not commit to field-level data transformation that could alter invoice amounts or tax treatment — make that explicit. Also we should limit the scope to onboarding and not change our invoicing acceptance policy broadly.

Attaching: Redwood_MSA_redline_aditya_20270509.pdf (redline focuses on Order Form appendix)
Attachment: OrderForm_PO-mapping-proposal.csv

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/EnvelopeID-89237

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

(Attachments: Redwood_MSA_redline_aditya_20270509.pdf, OrderForm_PO-mapping-proposal.csv)

From: James Smythe <j.smythe@horizonhealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@horizonhealth.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ariba PO import failing - Bill-To / PO number format

Aditya / Grace / Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround. We reviewed Marissa's redline and the CSV mapping template with our Ariba team. A few notes:
- The Order Form appendix looks good; the team confirmed they can accept numeric-only POs and will keep our internal prefix as a display-only field (no change to the validator).
- We'll sign the Order Form addendum via DocuSign later today.
- One small ask: can Redwood confirm that invoices with our display prefix (e.g., displayRef = "HZN-12345") will still match if the invoice PO field is sent as 12345? Our EDI logic does a strict match on the PO field.

If we get that confirmation we'll kick the automation again and re-run the supplier import. I'll update ticket https://ariba-horizon.example.com/ticket/12847 when we re-run.

Best,
James
Procurement Ops
Horizon Health

(Attachment: signed_orderform_addendum_docusign_receipt.pdf)
